---
name: Bug report
about: Something does not work or looks wrong
title: ""
labels: bug
---

**What happened**

**What you expected**

**Where in the game** (planet / level name, a cutscene, a menu, a shop... and what you were doing)

**Screenshot or clip** (for visual problems; for performance, a screenshot with the FPS counter on: F1 > Video > FPS counter)

**Your setup**
- Windows version:
- CPU (model) and GPU (model + driver version):
- RAM:
- Release version (shown in the F1 page title, e.g. 1.2.1):
- Game files: decrypted .iso / disc folder; made with (PS3 Disc Dumper, ps3dec...); the installer confirmed BCES00052 v01.00: yes / no
- Controller or keyboard:

**Settings** (attach or paste `tod.ini`: internal resolution `RSX_SCALE`, `RSX_AA`, `TOD_FPS`, language, anything you changed)

**Does it happen every time?** Does it also happen with the default settings (RSX_SCALE 1.5, MSAA x4, 60 fps)?

**Log**
Attach `log\tod.log` from right after the problem (before starting the game again: the previous run is kept as `log\tod.previous.log`).
If the game crashed or froze, the last lines are the most useful part.
Also attach the newest `log\tod_v2_<date>.jsonl` (the detailed log: press **F7** in game at the moment something goes wrong to mark it)
and, if the game crashed, `log\tod_crash.txt`.

Do not attach game files, disc images or other people's save data.
